title: FLA->SWF static text: embedded glyph outlines garble in Ruffle (a/e/i/o) + title not centered
description:
DONE (task 1193). Two bugs in the published golden.fla static-text path, both fixed.

ROOT CAUSE — BUG A (PRIMARY, multi-contour glyph garble): The SWF StyleChangeRecord MoveTo writes ABSOLUTE coordinates, but packages/swf/src/fonts.ts writeGlyphMoveTo wrote a pen-RELATIVE delta (x-penX, y-penY). Every other shape-record coord is a delta (StraightEdge/CurvedEdge) — MoveTo is the lone exception (Ruffle: render/src/shape_utils.rs does `self.cursor = *move_to;`, an assignment). A delta works only for the FIRST contour (pen starts at 0,0 so delta==absolute); the 2nd contour (counter of a/e/o, the 'i' dot) landed near the origin / below the baseline, collapsing multi-contour glyphs to a tiny blob while single-contour glyphs looked fine. Fill-style (fs0 vs fs1), zero-length lines, winding, and contour order were all RED HERRINGS — the glyphs parse correctly and Ruffle's NON_ZERO winding cuts holes regardless of order.
FIX A: writeGlyphMoveTo now emits absolute x,y (numBitsFor([x,y]); write x,y), dropping the unused penX/penY params. One-line semantic change.

ROOT CAUSE — BUG B (title left-aligned, not centered): align was imported but the compiler always passed XOffset=0 to encodeDefineText. Flash bakes horizontal alignment into the first TEXTRECORD XOffset.
FIX B: compile.ts computes XOffset from obj.align + obj.width: center=(boxWidthTwips-textWidthTwips)/2, right=full free width, left=0; new exported helper text.ts measureTextWidthTwips reuses the same per-glyph advances + baked kerning as encodeDefineText. Title now renders centered (XOffset 3553 twips vs golden 3640; visually centered, matches reference render). Remaining golden-parity sub-diffs (title y_offset 720 vs 660, button-label XOffset, a couple advances) stem from NotoSans-vs-Arial advances and authored baseline metrics we do not import — documented as parity gaps, NOT render defects; golden-parity stays exit 0.

FILES: packages/swf/src/fonts.ts (BUG A), packages/swf/src/compile.ts + packages/swf/src/text.ts (BUG B), tests packages/swf/src/__tests__/glyphoutline.test.ts (+ multi-contour absolute-MoveTo regression) and text.test.ts (+ alignment XOffset tests), CLAUDE.md learnings.

VERIFICATION (all reproducible):
- Visual oracle (acceptance truth): GOLDEN_SHOT_OUT=/tmp/ours_live.png pnpm --filter @flash/desktop e2e golden-fla-oracle → PASS; live publish path renders 'Test Game' centered + correct glyphs and 'Click to Play' correct, matching GOLDEN_REF_SWF=fixtures/golden/golden.swf reference (font weight differs = accepted Arial->NotoSans pivot). Saved /tmp/ours_live.png, /tmp/ref.png.
- apps/desktop/e2e/text-rendering.spec.ts → 2 passed (no regression).
- pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test -- --run → 1325 passed | 1 todo (107 files).
- pnpm --filter @flash/core run test -- --run → 5132 passed (320 files).
- node tools/golden-parity.mjs (golden) → exit 0; node tools/golden-parity.mjs fixtures/golden/golden-v2.fla fixtures/golden/golden-v2.swf → exit 0. TEXT PARITY shows title x_offset now 3553 (was 0); residual y_offset/advance gaps documented above.
